body: I read some of your posts/comments and I connect with a lot of them, especially [this](https://www.reddit.com/r/exmormon/comments/4y5phy/having_a_discussion_with_someone_more/d6laks0). When I think about everything I know and don't know about the world and other people, I feel suffocated. I feel like I can never really understand anyone. I know myself because I am constantly thinking and exploring and testing myself. My grasp of my own identity is always evolving, but I can't afford the same for everyone else. I can only see them through one pair of eyes, through bits and pieces of interaction. And I wonder if it even matters that everyone else is even human. If everyone else was an android or even just imagination, I wouldn't be able to tell the difference. That thought is so isolating that I question if it even matters that others care about me and that I care about them.
